The northernmost middle school in California is Butte Valley Middle, school type "Junior High Schools (Public)", at a latitude of 41.9642 degrees. No other middle school ties at that latitude. final.sql:
SELECT name AS japanese_name, type AS english_type, SUM(n) AS total_rulings
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT fd."name", c."type", c."uuid", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "rulings" r WHERE r."uuid" = c."uuid") AS n
  FROM "cards" c
  JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
) t
GROUP BY name, type
ORDER BY name, type
final.answer:
This query lists each Japanese-named card (grouped by Japanese name plus English type) that has a boros watermark and a Japanese printing, with its total ruling count summed across all its printings (0 if none). WITH t AS (
  SELECT t.trans_id, t.k_symbol
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.amount > 4000
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM disp d
      JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
      WHERE d.account_id = t.account_id
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
    )
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(k_symbol) <> '' AND k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS other_purpose,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(k_symbol) = '') AS no_purpose
FROM t

WITH gold_owner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, cl.gender
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE lower(c.type::text) = 'gold' AND lower(d.type::text) = 'owner'
),
acct_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_bal
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
  HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
),
dist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.gender, a.district_id
  FROM gold_owner g
  JOIN acct_avg aa ON aa.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
),
big AS (
  SELECT dt.gender, di.district_id, di.a4::bigint AS inhabitants, di.a11, di.a10
  FROM dist dt
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = dt.district_id
  WHERE di.a4::bigint > 100000
)
SELECT gender,
  COUNT(*) AS n_districts,
  MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants,
  STRING_AGG(district_id::text, ', ' ORDER BY district_id) FILTER (WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MAX(inhabitants) FROM big b2 WHERE b2.gender = big.gender)) AS top_district_ids,
  ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
  ROUND(AVG(a10)::numeric, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
FROM big
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY gender DESC;

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT a."district_id", SUM(t."amount") AS total_wd, COUNT(*) AS n_wd
  FROM "trans" t JOIN "account" a ON a."account_id" = t."account_id"
  GROUP BY a."district_id"
),
so AS (
  SELECT a."district_id", SUM(o."amount") AS so_total
  FROM "order" o JOIN "account" a ON a."account_id" = o."account_id"
  GROUP BY a."district_id"
),
acc AS (
  SELECT "district_id", COUNT(*) AS n_accounts FROM "account" GROUP BY "district_id"
),
base AS (
  SELECT d."district_id", d."a2" AS district_name, d."a3" AS region,
         CAST(d."a4" AS bigint) AS population,
         COALESCE(wd.total_wd,0) AS total_withdrawn,
         ROUND(COALESCE(wd.total_wd,0)::numeric / CAST(d."a4" AS bigint), 2) AS wd_per_inhab,
         ROUND(COALESCE(so.so_total,0)::numeric / NULLIF(acc.n_accounts,0), 2) AS so_per_account
  FROM "district" d
  JOIN wd ON wd."district_id" = d."district_id"
  LEFT JOIN so ON so."district_id" = d."district_id"
  LEFT JOIN acc ON acc."district_id" = d."district_id"
  WHERE d."a4" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(d."a4" AS bigint) >= 100000
)
SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, wd_per_inhab,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wd_per_inhab DESC) AS withdrawal_rank,
       so_per_account

SELECT s."superhero_name", p."publisher_name", ce."colour" AS eye_colour, ch."colour" AS hair_colour, cs."colour" AS skin_colour
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" ce ON s."eye_colour_id" = ce."id"
JOIN "colour" ch ON s."hair_colour_id" = ch."id"
JOIN "colour" cs ON s."skin_colour_id" = cs."id"
LEFT JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE ce."colour" = ch."colour" AND ch."colour" = cs."colour"
  AND ce."colour" NOT IN ('No Colour', '-')
ORDER BY s."superhero_name"

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s."school", s."charter", s."gsserved", f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS rate, f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS fcharter,
         sa."avgscrread" + sa."avgscrmath" + sa."avgscrwrite" AS sat_total, sa."cds" AS sat_cds
  FROM "schools" s
  JOIN "frpm" f ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
  LEFT JOIN "satscores" sa ON sa."cds" = s."cdscode"
  WHERE s."gsserved" = 'K-12' AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rate DESC) AS rk FROM base
)
SELECT "school", ROUND(rate::numeric, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
       CASE WHEN "charter" = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "charter" = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
       "gsserved" AS grades_served,
       CASE WHEN sat_cds IS NULL OR sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
            WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
            WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
            ELSE 'Above Average' END AS sat_level
FROM ranked WHERE rk = 1

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s."cdscode", s."fundingtype"
  FROM "schools" s
  WHERE s."closeddate" IS NULL AND s."fundingtype" IN ('Directly funded','Locally funded')
),
enr AS (
  SELECT b."fundingtype", b."cdscode",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100 AS frpm_pct
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN "frpm" f ON f."cdscode" = b."cdscode" AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
),
sat AS (
  SELECT b."fundingtype", (sc."avgscrread" + sc."avgscrmath" + sc."avgscrwrite") AS combined
  FROM base b
  JOIN "satscores" sc ON sc."cds" = b."cdscode"
  WHERE sc."avgscrread" IS NOT NULL AND sc."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL AND sc."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT b."fundingtype",
  COUNT(DISTINCT b."cdscode") AS open_school_count,
  SUM(e.enrollment) AS total_enrollment_2014_15,
  ROUND(AVG(e.frpm_pct)::numeric, 2) AS avg_frpm_pct_0_100,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(s2.combined)::numeric, 2) FROM sat s2 WHERE s2."fundingtype" = b."fundingtype") AS avg_combined_sat,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sat s2 WHERE s2."fundingtype" = b."fundingtype") AS sat_schools
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN enr e ON e."cdscode" = b."cdscode"
GROUP BY b."fundingtype"

SELECT "fundingtype", "school", "closeddate", "cdscode" FROM "schools" LIMIT 5

SELECT "fundingtype", COUNT(*), COUNT("closeddate") AS closed_dates FROM "schools" GROUP BY 1

SELECT s."fundingtype",
  COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") AS open_schools,
  SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS enrollment_2014_15,
  ROUND(AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)")::numeric, 2) AS avg_frpm_pct_row,
  ROUND(AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)")::numeric, 2) AS avg_free_pct_row,
  COUNT(f."cdscode") AS frpm_rows
FROM "schools" s
LEFT JOIN "frpm" f ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode" AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s."closeddate" IS NULL AND s."fundingtype" IN ('Directly funded','Locally funded')
GROUP BY s."fundingtype"

SELECT s."fundingtype", MIN(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") mn, MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") mx, COUNT(*) n_nonnull, COUNT(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") n_pct, COUNT(f."Enrollment (K-12)") n_enr
FROM "schools" s JOIN "frpm" f ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode" AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s."closeddate" IS NULL AND s."fundingtype" IN ('Directly funded','Locally funded')
GROUP BY 1

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s."cdscode", s."fundingtype"
  FROM "schools" s
  WHERE s."closeddate" IS NULL AND s."fundingtype" IN ('Directly funded','Locally funded')
),
enr AS (
  SELECT b."fundingtype", b."cdscode",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100 AS frpm_pct
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN "frpm" f ON f."cdscode" = b."cdscode" AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
),
sat AS (
  SELECT b."fundingtype", (sc."avgscrread" + sc."avgscrmath" + sc."avgscrwrite") AS combined
  FROM base b
  JOIN "satscores" sc ON sc."cds" = b."cdscode"
  WHERE sc."avgscrread" IS NOT NULL AND sc."avgscrmath" IS NOT NULL AND sc."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT b."fundingtype",
  COUNT(DISTINCT b."cdscode") AS open_school_count,
  SUM(e.enrollment) AS total_enrollment_2014_15,
  ROUND(AVG(e.frpm_pct)::numeric, 2) AS avg_frpm_pct_0_100,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(s2.combined)::numeric, 2) FROM sat s2 WHERE s2."fundingtype" = b."fundingtype") AS avg_combined_sat,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sat s2 WHERE s2."fundingtype" = b."fundingtype") AS sat_schools
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN enr e ON e."cdscode" = b."cdscode"
GROUP BY b."fundingtype"

)
AND c.score = 0

final.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT DISTINCT fd.name AS jname, c.type AS etype, c.uuid FROM foreign_data fd JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid), rc AS (SELECT uuid, count(*) AS n FROM rulings GROUP BY uuid) SELECT j.jname AS japanese_name, j.etype AS english_type, sum(COALESCE(rc.n, 0)) AS total_rulings FROM j LEFT JOIN rc ON rc.uuid = j.uuid GROUP BY j.jname, j.etype ORDER BY j.jname, j.etype
final.answer:
There are 96 distinct Japanese-printed boros-watermark cards (grouped by Japanese name + English type), with 236 official rulings in total across them. Cards with no rulings are included with a total of 0 (e.g., Hide // Seek / Instant, ウォジェクの号笛 / Instant, ボロスの導き石 / Artifact). Highest totals include 光り輝く炎 / Sorcery (12) and 炎まといの報復者 / Creature — Angel (10). The submitted SQL returns the full per-card list (Japanese name, English type, total rulings).

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL THEN 'id:' || p.owneruserid::text ELSE 'name:' || p.ownerdisplayname END) AS bounty_users
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON p.id = v.postid
WHERE v.bountyamount >= 30
  AND v.creationdate >= DATE '2010-01-01'
  AND v.creationdate < DATE '2011-01-01'
  AND (p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL OR p.ownerdisplayname IS NOT NULL)

32 users offered a bounty of 30 or more on a post between 1 January 2010 (inclusive) and 1 January 2011 (exclusive), by bounty record date. Users were identified by the post owner's user id where recorded, otherwise by the post's owner display name.

upvotes AS (

JOIN "users" u ON u."id" = a.uid

WITH acc_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avgbal FROM trans GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
),
gold_owner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, cl.gender
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
),
q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.gender, a.district_id
  FROM gold_owner g
  JOIN acc_avg aa ON aa.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
),
dist AS (
  SELECT q.gender, di.district_id, di.a4::bigint AS inhabitants, di.a10, di.a11
  FROM q JOIN district di ON di.district_id = q.district_id
  WHERE di.a4::bigint > 100000
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT dist.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY inhabitants DESC) AS rk,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS n,
         AVG(a11) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS avg_salary,
         AVG(a10) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS avg_urban
  FROM dist
)
SELECT gender, n AS num_districts, district_id, inhabitants,
       ROUND(avg_salary::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary, ROUND(avg_urban::numeric, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY gender, district_id

base AS (

WITH top_loans AS (
  SELECT l.* FROM "loan" l
  WHERE l."loan_id" IN (
    SELECT l2."loan_id" FROM "loan" l2
    JOIN "disp" dp ON dp."account_id" = l2."account_id"
    JOIN "client" c ON c."client_id" = dp."client_id"
    WHERE l2."amount" IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT l3."amount" FROM "loan" l3
      WHERE l3."loan_id" IN (SELECT l4."loan_id" FROM "loan" l4 JOIN "disp" d4 ON d4."account_id" = l4."account_id" JOIN "client" c4 ON c4."client_id" = d4."client_id")
      ORDER BY l3."amount" DESC LIMIT 3))
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT d."a3" AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT l."loan_id") AS region_loans
  FROM "district" d
  LEFT JOIN "account" a ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
  LEFT JOIN "loan" l ON l."account_id" = a."account_id"
  GROUP BY d."a3"
),
region_salary AS (
  SELECT "a3" AS region, ROUND(AVG(dist_avg)::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_salary
  FROM (SELECT "a3", "district_id", AVG("a11")::numeric AS dist_avg FROM "district" GROUP BY "a3", "district_id") x
  GROUP BY "a3"
),
acc_stats AS (
  SELECT a."account_id", COUNT(t."trans_id") AS tx_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t."operation" = 'PRIJEM' THEN t."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deposits
  FROM "account" a LEFT JOIN "trans" t ON t."account_id" = a."account_id"
  GROUP BY a."account_id"
)
SELECT c."client_id", tl."amount" AS loan_amount, tl."duration" AS duration_months,
  ROUND((tl."payments"::numeric * tl."duration"), 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND((tl."payments"::numeric * tl."duration" - tl."amount"), 2) AS interest_paid,
  tl."status" AS loan_status, d."a2" AS district, d."a3" AS region,
  ast."tx_count", ROUND(ast."deposits"::numeric, 2) AS total_deposits,
  CASE WHEN ast."deposits" > 2 * tl."amount" THEN 'High Income'
       WHEN ast."deposits" > tl."amount" THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category,
  rs."region_loans", rsal."region_avg_salary",
  DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', c."birth_date"))::int AS age_2026_10_09
FROM top_loans tl
JOIN "account" a ON a."account_id" = tl."account_id"
JOIN "district" d ON d."district_id" = a."district_id"
JOIN "disp" dp ON dp."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "client" c ON c."client_id" = dp."client_id"
JOIN acc_stats ast ON ast."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN (SELECT region, region_loans FROM region_stats) rs ON rs.region = d."a3"
JOIN region_salary rsal ON rsal.region = d."a3"
ORDER BY tl."amount" DESC

JOIN no_thromb t ON t.id = s.id
WHERE s.id IN (SELECT id FROM prot_sig)

WITH p AS (SELECT "id", left("sex",1) AS s FROM "patient" WHERE left("sex",1) IN ('M','F')),
abn AS (SELECT DISTINCT "id" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "cre" >= 1.5)
SELECT p.s AS sex,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE abn."id" IS NOT NULL) AS patients_out_of_range,
       COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE abn."id" IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct
FROM p LEFT JOIN abn ON abn."id" = p."id"
GROUP BY p.s ORDER BY p.s
final.answer:
Creatinine out of range (CRE >= 1.5):
- F: 7 patients with at least one out-of-range result, out of 1,023 female patients = 0.7%
- M: 7 patients with at least one out-of-range result, out of 202 male patients = 3.5%

The total per sex therefore counts only patients with a recognizable M/F code.
